title: MIND: A Multi-agent Framework for Zero-shot Harmful Meme Detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of harmful memes involving religious themes, irony, and stereotypes, particularly those targeting Islam.
findings: The framework struggled with ironic or satirical content involving religion. In one example, it failed to recognize the ironic juxtaposition between a peaceful message about Islam and threatening imagery (weapons), possibly due to an overly cautious approach where it prioritized the literal text over the conflicting visual context. This led to misclassifying a harmful meme as harmless.
references: Josh Achiam, Steven Adler, Sandhini Agarwal, Lama Ahmad, Ilge Akkaya, Florencia Leoni Aleman, Diogo Almeida, Janko Altenschmidt, Sam Altman, Shyamal Anadkat, et al. 2023. Gpt-4 technical report. arXiv preprint arXiv:2303.08774.
